scope: Players as effect owners; Shriek is PvE-only; Upside Down/Vision use bounded entity queries; Tomb Raider maps Java target tags to Bedrock entity IDs and preserves 40-tick pickup delay; other timed effects as C5

upside_down.source: Java 1.2.0: living Mob entities intersecting user AABB inflated by 16 are custom-named Grumm
upside_down.adapter: Bedrock mob-family query, living health check, exact getAABB overlap against source box inflated by 16, set Entity.nameTag='Grumm'
upside_down.divergence: Bedrock Script API exposes nameTag but no generic equivalent of Java setCustomNameVisible(false); visual/nameplate behavior requires engine acceptance

vision.source: Java 1.2.0: every 50 ticks, radius=min(amplifier+1,3)*6; other living entities get Glowing for 60 ticks; sound only when at least one target was not already Glowing
vision.adapter: Timed custom status; 5-tick scheduler detects crossed 50-tick countdown boundaries, applies native glowing for 60 ticks after exact AABB overlap, and plays kt_assets_a17.effect.vision only for newly glowing targets
vision.divergence: Pulse execution may occur within the existing 5-tick adapter cadence rather than on the exact Java entity tick; engine audio/effect rendering remains untested

tomb_raider.source: Java 1.2.0 LivingHurtEvent: attacker with Tomb Raider; selected skeleton/zombie/piglin/illager/witch types; target RNG < 0.3F; mainhand damageable item set to maxDamage-1; unequip/drop with pickup delay 40
tomb_raider.adapter: Bedrock entityHurt after-event; player custom-effect owner; exact mapped entity IDs; Java-float32 0.3 threshold; minecraft:equippable Mainhand; durability damage=maxDurability-1; spawnItem; item dynamic-property unlock plus entityItemPickup before-event cancellation for 40 ticks
tomb_raider.divergence: Java permits any LivingEntity effect owner; C6 custom effects remain player-owned. Bedrock entityHurt timing is after damage rather than Forge LivingHurtEvent timing; lethal-hit behavior requires engine acceptance
